name: Biblo
long_description:
Biblo is a personal AI agent that helps you get healthier, starting right in your texts.

Send Biblo a photo of your food to track calories and macros, log workouts, or get personalized coaching based on your goals.

But Biblo goes beyond tracking. It learns your habits, preferences, and routines to help you make decisions and take action. We're building it to handle things like ordering food that fits your goals, planning workouts around your schedule, and taking care of everyday tasks on your behalf.

Our vision is a personal AI that knows you well enough to anticipate what you need and get things done, not just answer questions.
one_liner: Your personal AI fitness coach, over iMessage.
